sources.new_regime_slabs: finance_act_2025_slabs_circular.pdf, section 202(1) table ("New tax regime for individuals, Hindu undivided family and others")
sources.rebate_87A: finance_act_2025_slabs_circular.pdf, sections 155-156 ("Rebate to be allowed in computing income-tax" / "Rebate of income-tax in case of certain individuals"); cross-checked against income_tax_act_1961_relevant_section.pdf, section 87A

standard_deduction.rule: Rs. 75,000 or the salary, whichever is less

rebate_87A.rule: 100% of income-tax payable or Rs. 60,000, whichever is less, if total income does not exceed Rs. 12,00,000

marginal_relief.applies_when: total income exceeds Rs. 12,00,000 and income-tax payable on such total income exceeds the amount by which total income exceeds Rs. 12,00,000
marginal_relief.rule: rebate = income-tax payable minus (total income - Rs. 12,00,000), so that the incremental tax on income above Rs. 12,00,000 never exceeds the incremental income above Rs. 12,00,000
marginal_relief.cap: the combined deduction under this rule cannot exceed the income-tax payable at the section 202(1) slab rates

old_regime.source: Verified against Income Tax Department (incometaxindia.gov.in) published FY 2025-26 rates: old regime slabs 0-2.5L nil, 2.5-5L 5%, 5-10L 20%, above 10L 30%; cess 4% on income tax plus surcharge, applicable to both regimes.

standard_deduction.rule: Rs. 50,000 or the salary, whichever is less, in any case other than new-regime computation

rebate_87A.rule: An individual resident in India, whose total income does not exceed Rs. 5,00,000, is entitled to a deduction of 100% of income-tax payable or Rs. 12,500, whichever is less

cess.applies_to: tax_before_cess (after rebate/marginal relief), same rate for both regimes
cess.source: Verified against Income Tax Department (incometaxindia.gov.in) published FY 2025-26 rates: old regime slabs 0-2.5L nil, 2.5-5L 5%, 5-10L 20%, above 10L 30%; cess 4% on income tax plus surcharge, applicable to both regimes.

unresolved: Surcharge rates/thresholds for individuals are not present in either PDF, and are not implemented in the engine.

finance_act_2025_slabs_circular.pdf is not literally a 'circular' - its section numbering (199-209, Chapter references, footnotes citing 'Finance Act, 2026, w.e.f. 1-4-2026') indicates it is full or near-full text of the new Income-tax Act, 2025, which restructures section numbers relative to the 1961 Act. The FY2025-26 applicability of this specific numbering should be verified against the Act's actual commencement provisions before relying on section citations (155/156/202/etc.) in user-facing content.
